name: Menu Link Attributes
description: Allows you to add attributes to menu links.

suggests.drupal/yaml_editor: Provides a nicer YAML editing experience on the available-attributes configuration form.

project_description:
This module allows you to add attributes to your menu links or their wrapping 
 elements.

 Installation ☝️ 
 
 Enable Menu Link Attributes module 
 Grant Use menu link attributes permission to users which should be able to set attributes on menu items 
 Set available attributes on /admin/config/menu_link_attributes/config 
 
 Screencasts 📺 
 
 Installation 
 Container attributes 
 Other widgets for editing attributes 
 
 Container attributes 
 In order to provide attributes for containers (wrapping 
 elements) you simply need to create a new attribute starting with container_ , those will be applied on the container automatically.

 Optional dependency 
 
 YAML Editor - Loads an Ace editor which makes YAML editing more fun
